pages.text: An $(item)Echo Obelisk$() carries essence on toward where it is needed. Two blocks tall on the ground, one on a wall or a ceiling.
The $(item)Attuning Fork$() joins them. I touch a source with it, then each obelisk in turn, then whatever should receive.

pages.title: Links
pages.text: Each link reaches 24 blocks. An obelisk sends down up to 4 branches and passes over any end that is full. Two obelisks joined carry both ways, and joining the same pair again parts them.$(br2)An altar receives, and so do most of the things I build.
